cond_0241.intro:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our team.
As a data scientist, you work with structured and unstructured data to find answers to complex problems. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—the goal is to extract useful information from data to support informed decisions.
You will apply analytical skills and data science knowledge to produce concrete results. You will coordinate with clients to understand their questions and needs, then work through their data environments to identify relevant patterns. You will develop algorithms and systems, selecting appropriate tools and frameworks to turn disparate data points into objective answers. The output is a clear understanding of what the data shows and how it can be used.
cond_0241.responsibilities:
Coordinate with clients to clarify their questions and data needs
Work through data-rich environments to identify relevant patterns and insights
Develop algorithms and systems suited to the problem at hand
Select and apply appropriate tools and frameworks to process disparate data points
Clean and build analytical data sets or pipelines from existing sources when data engineering resources are not available
Produce objective, evidence-based answers to support client decisions
Document findings and deliver a clear account of what the data means and how it can be applied

2+ Years of experience as a Data Scientist
Experience with scripting languages, including SQL, Python, or R
Knowledge of operations research techniques, including probability and statistical methods

Active Secret clearance
Ability to obtain a security clearance
Bachelor's degree

In an increasingly connected world, massive amounts of structured and unstructured data open new opportunities. As a data scientist at [Company name masked], you can help turn complex data sets into useful information to solve real problems. Across private and public sectors—from fraud detection to cancer research to national intelligence—we need you to help find the answers in the data.
On our team, you'll use your analytical skills and data science knowledge to create real-world impact. A large part of the role is staying in close contact with clients to understand their questions and needs, then digging into their data-rich environments to find the pieces of their information puzzle. You'll develop algorithms and systems and use the right combination of tools and frameworks to turn sets of disparate data points into objective answers to help clients make informed decisions. Ultimately, you'll walk clients through a clear understanding of the data, what it means, and how it can be used.
Work with us as we use data science for good.

Ability to obtain a security clearance
Bachelor's degree
Secret clearance
